session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling a bit anxious today. I just got a notice about my insurance claim, and it's all a bit overwhelming.
I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like to talk about what's going on with the insurance claim? I can help you figure it out.
I don't know how I messed this up. I thought I was handling everything on my own, but now I feel like I'm failing again.
It's okay to feel that way. You're not failing—you're just going through a tough time. Let me help you sort this out.
I keep thinking I should have known better. I feel so useless, like I can't even manage my own money without making a mistake.
You're not useless—you're human, and everyone makes mistakes. Let me help you figure out what went wrong and how to move forward.
I just feel like I'm always letting people down. I don't want to be like my brother, always needing help. I want to be strong on my own.
It's understandable to feel that way, but you're not alone in this. I can help you build the strength you're looking for—let's work on it together.
I'm scared I'll never get it right. Every time I try to do something on my own, I mess up. It's like I'm not cut out for this.
You're not failing—you're learning. I'm here to help you through this, and I believe in your ability to grow. Let's take it step by step.
I don't know how to stop feeling like this. I want to be strong, but I keep falling apart. It's so hard to do everything by myself.
You don't have to do everything by yourself. I'm here to support you, and we can figure this out together. Let's take it one step at a time.
I just wish I could stop feeling like I'm not enough. I try so hard, but it's never enough.
You're trying hard, and that means a lot. I believe in you, and I'm here to help you feel more confident in your own strength.
I'm trying, but it's like the harder I try, the more I feel like I'm failing. I don't know how to stop the guilt from creeping in.
You're not failing—you're struggling, and that's okay. I'm here to help you find ways to quiet the guilt and be kinder to yourself.
I feel like I'm stuck in this loop of guilt and failure. Every time I make a mistake, I feel like I'm proving I'm not capable. It's so hard to break free.
You're not stuck—you're just caught in a cycle that's hard to break on your own. I can help you find a way out, and I believe you're stronger than you think.
I keep telling myself I'm capable, but the guilt is louder. I feel like I'm not doing enough, and I don't know how to change that.
